name: s3files
description: S3 Files makes S3 buckets accessible as high-performance file systems powered by EFS.

subcommands.name: create-access-point
subcommands.description: Creates an S3 File System Access Point for application-specific access with POSIX user identity and root directory enforcement.

subcommands.name: create-file-system
subcommands.description: Creates an S3 File System resource scoped to a bucket or prefix within a bucket, enabling file system access to S3 data.

subcommands.name: create-mount-target
subcommands.description: Creates a mount target resource as an endpoint for mounting the S3 File System from compute resources in a specific Availability Zone and VPC.

subcommands.name: delete-access-point
subcommands.description: Deletes an S3 File System Access Point.

subcommands.name: delete-file-system
subcommands.description: Deletes an S3 File System.

subcommands.name: delete-file-system-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the IAM resource policy of an S3 File System.

subcommands.name: delete-mount-target
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified mount target.

subcommands.name: get-access-point
subcommands.description: Returns resource information for an S3 File System Access Point.

subcommands.name: get-file-system
subcommands.description: Returns resource information for the specified S3 File System including status, configuration, and metadata.

subcommands.name: get-file-system-policy
subcommands.description: Returns the IAM resource policy of an S3 File System.

subcommands.name: get-mount-target
subcommands.description: Returns detailed resource information for the specified mount target including network configuration.

subcommands.name: get-synchronization-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the synchronization configuration for the specified S3 File System, including import data rules and expiration data rules.

subcommands.name: list-access-points
subcommands.description: Returns resource information for all S3 File System Access Points associated with the specified S3 File System.

subcommands.name: list-file-systems
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all S3 File Systems owned by the account with optional filtering by bucket.

subcommands.name: list-mount-targets
subcommands.description: Returns resource information for all mount targets with optional filtering by file system, access point, and VPC.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags for S3 Files resources.

subcommands.name: put-file-system-policy
subcommands.description: Creates or replaces the IAM resource policy for an S3 File System to control access permissions.

subcommands.name: put-synchronization-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the synchronization configuration for the specified S3 File System, including import data rules and expiration data rules.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Creates tags for S3 Files resources using standard Amazon Web Services tagging APIs.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from S3 Files resources.

subcommands.name: update-mount-target
subcommands.description: Updates the mount target resource, specifically security group configurations.
